text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Annd next up is our daily life outside
Tracen Academy!
There's URA and academy stuff too...
Anyways, roll the footage!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
~♪ Which shop should we check out first,
Yanko-san, Maru-chan?
The craft shop? Or should we grab tea
first?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"'I wanna eat pancakes~! But first,
Love-chan's outfit!
Fufu, Love-chan seems kinda thrilled
today♪'"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'm finallllly going out with
Maru-chan!
Of course I'm gonna be excited and fool
around!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"'Ehehe, Maru-chan was looking forward to
it too!
We've both been so busy with races, after
all!'"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right. But even that makes me
happy, I suppose.
Being able to spend time here at Tracen
Academy with Maru-chan like this, even
now.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy when Maru-chan started the
kids' race too.
Because I'd always wanted to run together
with her—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Maru-chan finally came!" was my first
thought, but...
To think it'll continue like this from now
on. Nothing could make me happier!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"'Love-chan...!
Uuuugh, me too, me too! I feel the exact
same way!!'"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Nice, childhood friend power!
Alright, let's hit the shops and the cafe
and enjoy every single second!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I wonder what kind of outfit
would be best!
If I'm standing as an ambassador, I really
must consider how to make an impression.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
True. As an ambassador, you'll be invited
to all kinds of events,
so something between formal and casual
might be really versatile.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
And next... what about thinking about the
impression you want to make?
Go with bold colors if you want to look
confident, or pastel colors if you want to
look friendly!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I see! Yes, if that's the case... perhaps
something around here would be nice.
I'd like to project a dignified impression
that lives up to such an important role."

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"'Wah~, what a cool outfit set!
A mature Love-chan is bound to look
amazing! Let's try it on!'"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Go on ahead and try it on.
In the meantime, I'll pick out some shoes
and accessories♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Maru-chan, were you drawing?
Is this me in the outfit I tried on
earlier? So cute~♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, just like that—without the puppet. Let
me hear your real voice, Maru-chan.
...Yanko-san isn't here yet, so it's okay.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... um, I drew it while I was
waiting. I just couldn't resist...
Cool Love-chan looked so amazing, after
all.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to use that drawing in my fan
community stream. All my commu members
adore Maru-chan's illustrations, so I want
to show it to them♪

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Please, go ahead and use it...!
Ehehe, you really like it. ...I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... me too. Being together with you,
Love-chan...
being able to help you right now—makes me
so, so happy.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, I brought a bunch of items!
Try matching up whatever looks good~

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Lucky, found Ai and the gang!
What's up, what're you guys doing~?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
It's Yanko-senpai! Is this recording? Yay!
We were drawing pictures to put in the
live concert pamphlet!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ah, for the Fan Appreciation Live? We're
supposed to prepare comments and
illustrations, right?
You're super fired up, Kiseki! Are you
gonna make it a manga after all?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yep, manga is my thing, and I am the thing
of manga!
I decided to turn live concert tropes into
material.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Let me see, Kiseki! "Keeps Hachimii ready
to soothe her throat during concerts.
Drinks it all before the show starts
anyway"—Ahaha! That is SO her~!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Manga just makes you want to read it,
right?
Even with just two panels, you can deliver
a punchline and get a chuckle out of it!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The manga format certainly catches the
eye, doesn't it?
...Oh, Ai-san, have you finished drawing
yours too?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I chose an eye motif. My fans often
compliment me on how pretty my eyes are,
and my name is 'Eye,' after all.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ai-chan, let me see too!
—Wh-!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible... Such gaze power, it feels
like I'm being drawn right in...!
It's crystal clear yet has a deep blue...
sparkling just like stardust!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That is quintessential Ai-chan!
What incredible style and impact...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
――Urrgh, I can't let myself lose!
I'll show them! I'll make it even more
interesting!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Then Kiseki, wanna make it a serialized
series with me?
I wanna read waaaay more 'Live Performance
Relatables'!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"! A multi-part series! That way, we can
set up running gags and double
punchlines...!
Alright, let's brainstorm some material
together, Blast-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Lala? What kind of picture
did you draw?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I went for an ink wash painting style.
A single flower felt a bit lonely, so I
added a little message to it. What d'ya
think?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"! The brush texture has a wonderfully
subtle elegance. And...
the negative space. This white space
really works wonders...!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you noticed the little details I put
into this?
To think it caught Ai-san's discerning
eye. I'm truly delighted.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...There's still room for improvement
with my painting's colors.
I can't call it finished like this! I'm
going to make it better and better!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do it too! I'll make the
absolute, numbeeer one
most interesting manga of all!!
Uoooooohhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
We were supposed to just be drawing, but
before we knew it, it turned into a
competition.
Aha, that happens all the time at Tracen
Academy~. Everyone's just so competitive.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Though, I guess you already knew that.
After all, the one who's been supporting
us all this time is you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Though, I guess you already knew that.
After all, the one who's been supporting
us all this time is you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Whether it was walls so high I wanted to
give up, or hardships that crushed my
spirit...
The reason I could overcome them was
thanks to your strength."

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Whether it was walls so high I wanted to
give up, or hardships that crushed my
spirit...
The reason I could overcome them was
thanks to your strength."

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you! For everything up till
now, and everything to come!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
With you by my side, even an impenetrable
boundary—can surely be crossed!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
If it's with you, even an impassable
boundary—I'm sure we can cross it!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Innovation!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Dreams become reality. From here on lies
what's beyond the dream you achieved.
Let's go! Toward a future of boundless
possibilities!"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Dreams become reality. From here on lies
what's beyond the dream you achieved.
Let's go! Toward a future of boundless
possibilities!"
